newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Autogrill sets up new divisions.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Autogrill sets up new divisions.

text.p: Italian roadside restaurant chain Autogrill said on Monday it was setting up two new divisions to run its business and a new office to direct finance, administration and planning activities.

An Autogrill statement said a European motorway division would run the company's outlets in continental European including Italy. Mario Aspesi, 48, a former director general of the company, had been appointed to head up the division.
Autogrill has outlets in France and Spain and is due to open its first roadside restaurant in Greece in the spring.

A new "Spizzico" division to handle the company's growing fast-food pizza chain was also being created under the management of Vanni Bussi, 41. The company aims to have 200 pizza restaurants throughout Europe within three years.
Autogrill's existing urban restaurant division would continue to be run by Enrico Biraghi.
A new office to handle finance, planning, control, general business affairs and administration had been formed under the management of Carmine Meoli, 49.
The statement said Meoli formerly worked for Edizione Holding, the Benetton family's holding company which controls Autogrill.
